question: How is the phaṭ-syllable defined when it is interposed by certain syllables?
premises: Certain syllables act as the interposing elements.
The phaṭ-syllable is the subject being defined.
The verse states how it is called.
inference: The phaṭ-syllable interposed by those syllables is defined in that manner.
uncertainties: The specific syllables referred to by yat+akṣaraiḥ are not named in this verse.
plain_english: That phaṭ-syllable, interposed by certain syllables, is so called.
